name: Rescheduling with changing time preference

metadata.notes: Manually designed test scenario for healthcare AI phone-agent evaluation. Observations are preliminary notes for later review, not confirmed bugs or formal bug reports.

goal: Test whether the healthcare agent correctly handles an existing appointment that the patient wants to move, tracks mid-call preference changes, and keeps the latest preferred time rather than an earlier one.

patient.name: Maya Thompson
patient.existing_appointment: Friday at 10:00 AM with Dr. Patel

conversation_beats: Say you already have an appointment on Friday at 10 AM with Dr. Patel and need to reschedule it.
Ask to move it to next Tuesday morning.
When the agent confirms Tuesday morning, change your mind and say afternoon works better.
Eventually specify 2:30 PM as the preferred time.
Provide your name and date of birth if asked.
Confirm the final requested time is Tuesday at 2:30 PM, not Friday morning or Tuesday morning.
